description: Entirely synthetic CMBS servicing, collateral, and correction documents. No real borrowers or loans.

documents.content: Loan A, Harbor Tower, is an office CMBS loan. Original principal was $20.0 million, coupon 5.20%, and original maturity June 2027.
Loan B, Maple Apartments, is a multifamily CMBS loan. Original principal was $15.0 million, coupon 4.80%, and maturity December 2029.
Loan C, Sunset Retail, is a retail CMBS loan. Original principal was $12.0 million, coupon 6.10%, and maturity December 2026.
Loan D, River Logistics, is an industrial CMBS loan. Original principal was $30.0 million, coupon 4.40%, and maturity April 2030.
Loan E, Oak Hotel, is a lodging CMBS loan. Original principal was $9.0 million, coupon 7.00%, and maturity March 2027.
Harbor Tower, Loan A: 2025 DSCR was 1.35x; 2026 DSCR fell to 1.08x. Reported 2026 occupancy was 82%.
Maple Apartments, Loan B: 2025 DSCR was 1.65x; 2026 DSCR improved to 1.72x. Reported 2026 occupancy was 95%.
Sunset Retail, Loan C: 2025 DSCR was 0.98x; 2026 DSCR fell to 0.75x. Reported 2026 occupancy was 74%.
River Logistics, Loan D: 2025 DSCR was 1.80x; 2026 DSCR improved to 2.05x. Reported 2026 occupancy was 99%.
Oak Hotel, Loan E: 2025 DSCR was 1.10x; 2026 DSCR fell to 0.92x. The initial October 2026 occupancy report was 65%, later corrected.
Loan A September 2026 remittance: 30 days delinquent. Originally reported September ending scheduled principal balance was $19.2 million; later restated.
Loan A October 2026 remittance: 60 days delinquent. October ending scheduled principal balance was $18.7 million.
Loan B September 2026 remittance: current payment status; September ending scheduled principal balance $14.2 million.
Loan B October 2026 remittance: current payment status; October ending scheduled principal balance $14.1 million.
Loan C September 2026 remittance: 90 days delinquent. Originally reported September ending scheduled principal balance was $11.4 million; later restated.
Loan C October 2026 remittance: foreclosure proceedings initiated; October ending scheduled principal balance $10.9 million.
Loan D September 2026 remittance: current payment status; September ending scheduled principal balance $28.1 million.
Loan D October 2026 remittance: current payment status; October ending scheduled principal balance $27.9 million.
Loan E September 2026 remittance: current payment status; September ending scheduled principal balance $8.7 million.
Loan E October 2026 remittance: 30 days delinquent; October ending scheduled principal balance $8.6 million.
Harbor Tower, Loan A: October 2026 appraisal value $18.2 million versus $25.0 million in 2024.
Maple Apartments, Loan B: September 2026 appraisal value $19.0 million.
Sunset Retail, Loan C: October 2026 appraisal value $8.5 million versus $11.0 million in 2024.
River Logistics, Loan D: October 2026 appraisal value $38.0 million.
Oak Hotel, Loan E: October 2026 appraisal value $8.0 million.
Loan A modification signed November 2026: new maturity June 2028, replacing original June 2027 maturity; borrower funded a $0.5 million reserve.
Loan C entered foreclosure in October 2026; special servicer is evaluating liquidation options. No actual recovery proceeds have been reported.
Loan D defeasance notice received November 2026; no completed defeasance transaction is recorded as of that notice.
Loan E transferred to special servicing in November 2026 after its October delinquency; no loan modification is reported.
October 2026 correction notice for Loan A September 2026 remittance: corrected September ending scheduled principal balance $18.9 million, superseding the originally reported $19.2 million.
October 2026 correction notice for Loan C September 2026 remittance: corrected September ending scheduled principal balance $11.1 million, superseding the originally reported $11.4 million.
November 2026 correction notice for Oak Hotel, Loan E: corrected October 2026 occupancy to 68%, superseding the original 65% figure.
